test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In August 2025, the Department of Posts signed a Memorandum of Understanding with which association in an effort to broaden access to mutual fund products, leveraging the trust and reach of post offices across the country?

options.text: All India Association of Mutual Fund Advisors
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
Association of Mutual Funds in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Association of Mutual Funds in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **August 2025**, the **Department of Posts** (operating as **India Post**) officially signed a **Memorandum of Understanding** (**MoU**) with the **Association of Mutual Funds in India** (**AMFI**).
 
• The primary objective of this strategic partnership is to broaden the access to **mutual fund** products across the length and breadth of the country, specifically targeting **rural** and **semi-urban** populations.
 
• By leveraging the extensive network of over **1,60,000** **post offices**, the initiative seeks to utilize the high level of **trust** and **last-mile connectivity** that the **postal department** enjoys in India.
 
• This collaboration aims to facilitate **financial inclusion** by providing a simplified and reliable platform for common citizens to invest in **market-linked** financial instruments.
 
• The move is expected to significantly increase the penetration of **Systematic Investment Plans** (**SIPs**) and other **mutual fund** schemes among **retail investors** who previously had limited access to formal **wealth management** services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Department of Posts (India Post):**
 
 
• It functions under the **Ministry of Communications** of the **Government of India**.
 
• Established in **1854** by **Lord Dalhousie**, it has grown into the most widely distributed **postal network** in the world.
 
• Beyond traditional mail, it provides various **financial services** through the **Post Office Savings Bank** (**POSB**), which is one of the oldest and largest **banking systems** in the country.
 
 
 
• **Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI):**
 
 
• **AMFI** is the **apex body** of all **Asset Management Companies** (**AMCs**) in India that are registered with **SEBI**.
 
• It was incorporated on **August 22, 1995**, as a non-profit organization to maintain **professional standards** and ethics in the **mutual fund** industry.
 
• One of its major functions is to promote **investor awareness** through campaigns like "**Mutual Funds Sahi Hai**."
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Oversight:**
 
 
• The **mutual fund** industry in India is regulated by the **Securities and Exchange Board of India** (**SEBI**), established under the **SEBI Act, 1992**.
 
• **SEBI** ensures **transparency**, protects **investor interests**, and monitors the **Net Asset Value** (**NAV**) disclosures of various schemes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Financial Inclusion Goals:** This **MoU** aligns with the **Government of India’s** mission to ensure that **financial services** reach the "**Antyodaya**" (the last person in the queue).
 
• **Reach Statistics:** While **private banks** and **broking firms** are concentrated in **Tier-1** and **Tier-2** cities, **India Post** reaches more than **6,00,000** villages, providing a unique **geographical advantage** for **AMFI** members.
 
• **Diversification:** The introduction of **mutual funds** via **post offices** allows traditional savers to transition from **fixed-income** assets like **Fixed Deposits** (**FDs**) to **equity** and **hybrid** funds, potentially earning higher **inflation-adjusted returns** over the **long term**.
 
• **Trust Factor:** For many **rural** households, the **Postman** or **Gramin Dak Sevak** is a **trusted advisor**, making the adoption of new **financial products** smoother compared to **digital-only** platforms.
